quotes.text:
/**
   * Move a folder from one parent to another.
   * Folders cannot be:
   * - made descendants of themselves.
   * - promoted to root folders.
   * - moved from one server (root) to another
   * (Although the last restriction could potentially be lifted in future)
   */
  void moveFolderTo(in unsigned long long newParent,
                    in unsigned long long child);

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The accepted moveFolderTo rejects a root child, rejects moving a folder into itself or its descendants, and rejects a different root. Moving to the current parent is a no-op. The code notes the cross-server restriction could belong in the nsIMsgFolder layer, but it still enforces it here. Preserve the present guards until an intentional change updates the callers and tests; a TODO is not authorization to remove a live guard. Static inspection supports this component scope. No runtime test was run for this lesson, and full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is still pending.
title: Guard reparenting against roots, self-cycles and cross-server moves
